name: Beach Holidays
slug: beach-holidays
status: approved
summary: >-
  The beaches of Brazil and the Caribbean are ideal both for a standalone holiday and for several restful days after a busy itinerary.

## Choose the beach as part of the route

Búzios, Ilha Grande, Angra dos Reis, northeastern Brazil and the Caribbean differ in travel logistics, season and holiday format. When choosing, consider your arrival airport and the transfer time to the coast.

## A few days by the ocean after a major journey

After cities, domestic flights and sightseeing, it feels good to leave several days by the sea without a busy schedule. On a short trip, reverse the plan: make the beach your principal destination and add two or three days in a city.

## Match active days to your fitness

The Amazon, Patagonia, Andes, Iguaçu and Atlantic coast call for different preparation and equipment. Alternate active days with quieter ones, especially on a long journey.

## Weather can change the plan

In natural regions, weather and transport conditions can affect the schedule. A little extra time makes it easier to move a hike or excursion without putting your next flights at risk.

## First decide where and how to fish

Freshwater fishing and sea outings require different seasons, boats, transfers and equipment. Choose the fishing format and number of days on the water first, then add the other parts of the journey.

## Add other regions to a fishing trip

In Brazil, combine fishing with the Amazon and other regions of the country. In Argentina and Patagonia, it fits well alongside nature travel. Specific locations, seasons, permits and availability are confirmed for your dates.

## Fewer transfers, more time together

For a trip with children, attractions are not the only consideration. Long drives, early departures, altitude and heat can quickly be tiring, so a free day may be more valuable than another excursion.

## Combine cities, nature and beaches

In Brazil, you can combine Rio, Iguaçu, nature and several days beside the ocean. In Argentina, add Patagonia to Buenos Aires; in Peru, allow extra time for altitude and transfers. The route is tailored to the children's ages and the family's interests.

## A few quiet days between transfers

After several flights or active days, you can stay at a resort or hot-spring destination, or simply spend a few days on a more relaxed schedule.

## Choose the setting for the holiday you want

Some travellers need a break after an intensive journey; others want a particular spa hotel or natural thermal pools. That determines the destination and how many days to stay.
